scripts.>>> SERVER <<<: Builds and runs the server on local machine
scripts.server:local: dotnet --version TODO: Run the server specifically on host and port
scripts.>>> SYNC <<<: Sync the project to the native SDK manager
scripts.>>> DEPLOY <<<: Deploys to app stores and/or web server
scripts.deploy:development: npm run deploy:development:android && npm run deploy:development:ios
scripts.deploy:production: npm run deploy:production:android && npm run deploy:production:ios
scripts.package:development:android: npm run build:development:web && npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew bundleDebug
scripts.package:production:android: npm run build:production:web && npm run sync:android && cd android && gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.>>> BUILD AND DEPLOY <<<: Builds Packages and Deploys to the store
scripts.build-and-deploy:development:android: npm run package:development:android && npm run deploy:development:android
scripts.build-and-deploy:development: npm run build-and-deploy:development:web && npm run build-and-deploy:development:android && npm run build-and-deploy:development:ios
scripts.build-and-deploy:production:android: npm run package:production:android && npm run deploy:production:android
scripts.build-and-deploy:production: npm run build-and-deploy:production:web && npm run build-and-deploy:production:android && npm run build-and-deploy:production:ios
scripts.open_native:android: npm run sync:android && npx cap build android
scripts.open_native:ios: npm run sync:ios && npx cap build ios
scripts.>>> RUN <<<: Runs the app on the device
scripts.run:android: npm run sync:android && npx cap run android
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync:ios && npx cap run ios
scripts.build:localhost:web: vite build --mode localhost && node scripts/set-capacitor-config.ts localhost
scripts.build:localhost:android: npm run build:localhost:web && npm run run:android
scripts.build:localhost:ios: npm run build:localhost:web && npm run run:ios
scripts.build:localhost: npm run build:localhost:web && npm run run:android && npm run run:ios
scripts.build:development:web: tsc && vite build --mode development && node scripts/set-capacitor-config.ts development
scripts.build:development:android: npm run build:development:web && npm run run:android
scripts.build:development:ios: npm run build:development:web && npm run run:ios
scripts.build:development: npm run build:development:web && npm run run:android && npm run run:ios
scripts.build:production:web: tsc && vite build --mode production && node scripts/set-capacitor-config.ts production
scripts.build:production:android: npm run build:production:web && npm run run:android
scripts.build:production:ios: npm run build:production:web && npm run run:ios
scripts.build:production: npm run build:production:web && npm run run:android && npm run run:ios
